kit.name: Mosh Pit
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Mosh</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. On landing, create a zone that deals low <debuffred>damage</> over time before exploding, dealing high <debuffred>damage</> to all players. Reverts to a <whitebold>Globule</>.

kit.name: Wingman
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Wingman</>. FIRE to send it forward. <debuffred>Chases</> the first enemy it sees, <debuffred>concussing</> on impact. ALT FIRE to have <whitebold>Wingman</> plant or defuse at a targeted bomb site. Reverts to a <whitebold>Globule</>.

kit.name: Dizzy
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Dizzy</>. FIRE to throw. Fires plasma at enemies in line of sight, <debuffred>blinding</> them. Reverts to a <whitebold>Globule</>.

kit.name: Thrash
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Thrash</>. FIRE to take control. FIRE again to lunge and explode, <debuffred>detaining</> all players. FIRE while lunging to explode early. Reverts to a <whitebold>Globule</> only once.

kit.name: Globule
kit.description: Gekko’s abilities transform into a <whitebold>Globule</> after use. INTERACT to reclaim nearby <whitebold>Globules</> to gain another charge after a short cooldown.

kit.name: Prowler
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Prowler</>. FIRE to send it forward. HOLD FIRE to steer towards your crosshair. <debuffred>Chases</> the first enemy or <whitebold>Terror Trail</> it sees, <debuffred>nearsighting</> on impact.

kit.name: Seize
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Seize</>. FIRE to throw. REACTIVATE to drop early. On landing, <debuffred>deafen</>, <debuffred>decay</>, and <debuffred>tether</> enemies.

kit.name: Haunt
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Haunt</>. FIRE to throw. REACTIVATE to drop early. On landing, <debuffred>mark</> and <debuffred>reveal</> enemies in range and line of sight.

kit.name: Nightfall
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Nightfall</>. FIRE to send forward a wave that <debuffred>deafens</>, <debuffred>decays</>, and <debuffred>marks</> enemies.

kit.name: Terror Trails
kit.description: <debuffred>Marked</> enemies have their location tracked by <whitebold>Terror Trails</>.

kit.name: Aftershock
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Aftershock</>. FIRE to send a zone through a wall, exploding to repeatedly deal <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

kit.name: Flashpoint
kit.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>Flashpoint</>. FIRE to send it through a wall, exploding to <debuffred>flash</> all players looking at it.

kit.name: Fault Line
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Fault Line</>. HOLD FIRE to increase distance. RELEASE to detonate a zone that <debuffred>concusses</> all players.

kit.name: Rolling Thunder
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Rolling Thunder</>. FIRE to send forward a wave that <debuffred>concusses</> and <debuffred>knocks up</> all players.

kit.name: Barrier Mesh
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Barrier Mesh</>. FIRE to throw. On landing, create destructible markers that fortify after a delay. These markers form barriers that block player movement.

kit.name: Sonic Sensor
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Sonic Sensor</>. FIRE to place. Triggers on nearby detected enemy noise, creating a zone that <debuffred>concusses</> all players. <whitebold>Sonic Sensor</> <teal>stealths</> after placement. Can be picked up.

kit.name: GravNet
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>GravNet</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. Explodes on landing, forcing all players to <debuffred>crouch</> and move <debuffred>slowly</> until they remove the net.

kit.name: Annihilation
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Annihilation</>. FIRE to launch a zone, forcing the first enemy caught into a destructible cocoon that pulls them along a path for <debuffred>lethal damage</> unless the cocoon is destroyed.

kit.name: Stealth Drone
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Stealth Drone</>. FIRE to take control. FIRE again to <debuffred>reveal</> and <debuffred>suppress</> nearby enemies in range and line of sight.

kit.name: Special Delivery
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Special Delivery</>. FIRE to launch. ALT FIRE to launch with a bounce. Explodes on any surface, <debuffred>concussing</> and <debuffred>damaging</> all players.

kit.name: Guided Salvo
kit.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set locations. ALT FIRE to launch missiles that travel to and repeatedly pulse, dealing <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

kit.name: Armageddon
kit.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set, pivot and FIRE again to cast a wave that deals high <debuffred>damage</> to all players. ALT FIRE to cancel targeting.

kit.name: Boom Bot
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Boom Bot</>. FIRE to send it forward. <debuffred>Chases</> the first enemy it sees, exploding and dealing <debuffred>damage</> to enemies on impact.

kit.name: Blast Pack
kit.description: INSTANTLY throw a destructible <whitebold>Blast Pack</> that sticks to surfaces that fully arms after a delay. REACTIVATE to detonate, <debuffred>knocking away</> anything hit. If fully armed, <whitebold>Blast Pack</> will also deal <debuffred>damage</> to enemies.

kit.name: Paint Shells
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Paint Shells</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. After a delay, explode, dealing <debuffred>damage</> and creating sub-munitions, each also dealing <debuffred>damage</> to all players. Resets every two kills.

kit.name: Showstopper
kit.description: INSTANTLY prepare <whitebold>Showstopper</>. FIRE to launch. Explodes on any surface, dealing high <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

kit.name: Trademark
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Trademark</>. FIRE to place. Triggers on nearby visible enemies in range, creating a zone that <debuffred>slows</> all players. Can be recalled.

kit.name: Headhunter
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Headhunter</>. FIRE to shoot. ALT FIRE to aim down sights.

kit.name: Rendezvous
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Rendezvous</>. FIRE to place. While in range, REACTIVATE to instantly teleport to it. Can be recalled.

kit.name: Tour De Force
kit.description: ACTIVATE to access a sniper rifle that deals <debuffred>lethal damage</> with direct hits to the upper body. FIRE to shoot. ALT FIRE to aim down sights. On kills, create a zone that <debuffred>slows</> all players.

kit.name: FRAG/ment
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>FRAG/ment</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. Explodes on landing, repeatedly dealing pulses of <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

kit.name: FLASH/drive
kit.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>FLASH/drive</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. After a delay, explode, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it.

kit.name: ZERO/point
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>ZERO/point</>. FIRE to throw. Pulses on any surface, <debuffred>suppressing</> enemies within range.

kit.name: NULL/cmd
kit.description: INSTANTLY gain <teal>overloaded</> and repeatedly send out a pulse that <debuffred>suppresses</> enemies within range. <teal>Overloaded</> grants <teal>combat stim</>. Upon taking <debuffred>lethal damage</>, KAY/O is downed and can be re-stabilized.

kit.name: Regrowth
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Regrowth</>. HOLD FIRE to <teal>heal</> allies in range and line of sight. Uses a limited healing pool. Cannot heal self.

kit.name: Trailblazer
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Trailblazer</>. FIRE to take control. FIRE again to lunge and explode, <debuffred>concussing</> all players and dealing <debuffred>damage</> to enemies on direct hits.

kit.name: Guiding Light
kit.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>Guiding Light</>. FIRE to send it forward. HOLD FIRE to steer towards your crosshair. REACTIVATE to detonate, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it.

kit.name: Seekers
kit.description: EQUIP destructible <whitebold>Seekers</>. FIRE to send out up to three <whitebold>Seekers</>. <debuffred>Chases</> the three closest enemies, <debuffred>nearsighting</> and <debuffred>slowing</> on impact.

kit.name: Trapwire
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Trapwire</>. FIRE to place a wire between surfaces. <whitebold>Trapwire</> <teal>stealths</> after placement. Triggers when enemies come in contact, <debuffred>tethering</> enemies, and after a delay, <debuffred>revealing</> them if <whitebold>Trapwire</> is not destroyed. Can be picked up.

kit.name: Cyber Cage
kit.description: INSTANTLY throw a <whitebold>Cyber Cage</>. INTERACT to create a vision-blocking cylinder that plays an audio cue when enemies come in contact. Can be picked up during BUY PHASE.

kit.name: Spycam
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Spycam</>. FIRE to place. <whitebold>Spycam</> <teal>stealths</> after placement. REACTIVATE to control it. FIRE to shoot a dart that <debuffred>snapshots</> enemies hit until they remove it. Can be picked up.

kit.name: Neural Theft
kit.description: ACTIVATE on a targeted dead enemy. After a delay, <debuffred>snapshot</> living enemies twice.

kit.name: Owl Drone
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Owl Drone</>. FIRE to take control. FIRE again to shoot a dart that repeatedly <debuffred>reveals</> enemies.

kit.name: Shock Bolt
kit.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>Shock Bolt</>. FIRE to shoot a bolt that explodes on any surface, dealing <debuffred>damage</> to all players. HOLD FIRE to increase the bolt’s velocity. ALT FIRE to add up to two bounces.

kit.name: Recon Bolt
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Recon Bolt</>. FIRE to shoot a bolt that repeatedly <debuffred>reveals</> nearby enemies in range and line of sight. HOLD FIRE to increase the bolt’s velocity. ALT FIRE to add up to two bounces.

kit.name: Hunter's Fury
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Hunter’s Fury</>. FIRE to shoot a zone that deals <debuffred>damage</>. Can be fired up to two more times. Enemies hit are <debuffred>revealed</> to Sova.

kit.name: M-pulse
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>M-Pulse</>. ALT FIRE to toggle between <debuffred>concuss</> or <teal>heal</>. FIRE to throw. Repeatedly pulses on landing, applying the selected effect on all players within range.

kit.name: Harmonize
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Harmonize</>. FIRE on a targeted ally to grant <teal>combat stim</> and <teal>haste</> to them and yourself. On kills while active, refresh the <teal>buff</> if both <whitebold>Harmonized</> players are still alive. ALT FIRE to self-cast with no refresh.

kit.name: Waveform
kit.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set smoke locations. ALT FIRE to cast smokes.

kit.name: Bassquake
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Bassquake</>. FIRE to send forward a zone that <debuffred>deafens</>, <debuffred>knocks back</>, and <debuffred>slows</> all players.

kit.name: Nanoswarm
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Nanoswarm</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. <whitebold>Nanoswarm</> <teal>stealths</> after landing. INTERACT to create a zone that deals <debuffred>damage</> to all players. Can be picked up during BUY PHASE.

kit.name: ALARMBOT
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Alarmbot</>. FIRE to place. <whitebold>Alarmbot</> <teal>stealths</> after placement. Triggers on nearby visible enemies in range. <debuffred>Chases</> the first enemy it sees, exploding and applying <debuffred>vulnerable</>. Can be recalled.

kit.name: TURRET
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Turret</>. While equipped, REACTIVATE to flip the direction or HOLD ALT FIRE to rotate. FIRE to place. Shoots at enemies in line of sight. Can be recalled.

kit.name: Lockdown
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Lockdown</>. FIRE to prepare a zone. After a delay, <debuffred>detain</> enemies within range.

kit.name: Storm Surge
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Storm Surge</>. FIRE to throw. Explodes on landing, <debuffred>nearsighting</> and <debuffred>slowing</> all players.

kit.name: High Tide
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>High Tide</>. FIRE to send forward a vision-blocking wall that <debuffred>slows</> all players who come in contact. HOLD FIRE to steer towards your crosshair. ALT FIRE to stop early.

kit.name: Cove
kit.description: ENTER The Deep. REACTIVATE to cast a smoke. HOLD FIRE/ALT FIRE to adjust distance. RELOAD to toggle view. After casting, REACTIVATE to transform the smoke into a destructible shield.

kit.name: Reckoning
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Reckoning</>. FIRE to push forward a vision-blocking wall that <debuffred>nearsights</> and <debuffred>slows</> all players who come in contact. REACTIVATE to stop the wall early.

kit.name: Razorvine
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Razorvine</>. FIRE to throw. <whitebold>Razorvine</> <teal>stealths</> after landing. INTERACT to create a zone that <debuffred>slows</> and deals <debuffred>damage</> when players move through it. Can be recalled during BUY PHASE.

kit.name: Shear
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Shear</>. FIRE to place. <whitebold>Shear</> <teal>stealths</> after placement. Triggers when enemies walk on it, and after a delay, create a brief indestructible wall. Can be recalled during BUY PHASE.

kit.name: Arc Rose
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Arc Rose</>. FIRE to place. ALT FIRE to place it through a wall. REACTIVATE to <debuffred>flash</> all players looking at it. Can be recalled.

kit.name: Steel Garden
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Steel Garden</>. FIRE to prepare a zone. After a delay, <debuffred>jam</> enemy primary weapons within range.

kit.name: Snake Bite
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Snake Bite</>. FIRE to launch. On landing, create a zone that grants <debuffred>vulnerable</> and deals low <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

kit.name: Poison Cloud
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Poison Cloud</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. REACTIVATE to consume fuel to create a <whitebold>toxic</> smoke that <debuffred>decays</> enemies. Can be picked up during BUY PHASE.

kit.name: Toxic Screen
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Toxic Screen</>. FIRE to send forward and place a line of emitters. REACTIVATE to consume fuel to create a <whitebold>toxic</> vision-blocking wall that <debuffred>decays</> enemies.

kit.name: Viper's Pit
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Viper’s Pit</>. FIRE to form a large <whitebold>toxic</> vision-blocking cloud that <debuffred>decays</> enemies inside. HOLD ACTIVATE to cancel the cloud.

kit.name: Toxin
kit.description: Viper’s <whitebold>Toxin</> continuously inflicts <debuffred>decay</> when enemies come in contact. Passively recharge fuel over time.

kit.name: Flow
kit.description: INSTANTLY create an anchor. If Hush is in the air, briefly levitate in place. After a delay, propel towards it.

kit.name: Flashbulb
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Flashbulb</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to prepare it instead. REACTIVATE to direct it towards your crosshair. Explodes on any surface or after a delay, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it.

kit.name: Displacement
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Displacement</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to prepare it instead. REACTIVATE to direct it towards your crosshair. Explodes on any surface or after a delay, <debuffred>pulling</> all players towards the center and <debuffred>concussing</> them if they collide with any surface or another player. Resets every two kills.

kit.name: Suspension
kit.description: INSTANTLY prepare <whitebold>Suspension</>. FIRE to send it forward, steering with your crosshair. REACTIVATE or press FIRE again to detonate, <debuffred>levitating</> all players.

kit.name: Telekinesis
kit.description: Hush can pick up weapons, the Spike, and INTERACT with switches from an increased range.

kit.name: Blaze
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Blaze</>. FIRE to send forward a vision-blocking <whitebold>fire</> wall that deals <debuffred>damage</> to all players. HOLD FIRE to steer towards your crosshair.

kit.name: Hot Hands
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Hot Hands</>. FIRE to throw. ALT FIRE to lob. On landing, create a <whitebold>fire</> zone that deals <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

kit.name: Curveball
kit.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>Curveball</>. FIRE to curve left, ALT FIRE to curve right. After a delay, explode, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it. Resets every two kills.

kit.name: Run it Back
kit.description: INSTANTLY place a marker at your location. Upon taking <debuffred>lethal damage</> or when <whitebold>Run it Back</> expires, return to the marker with full health and the amount of armor you had when the ability was activated.

kit.name: Inner Fire
kit.description: Phoenix <teal>heals</> while standing in his own <whitebold>fire</> instead of taking damage.

kit.name: Crosscut
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Crosscut</>. FIRE to place. While in range, INTERACT to teleport to it. Can be recalled during BUY PHASE.

kit.name: Chokehold
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Chokehold</>. FIRE to throw. <whitebold>Chokehold</> <teal>stealths</> after landing. Triggers on nearby visible enemies in range, <debuffred>deafening</>, <debuffred>decaying</>, and <debuffred>tethering</> enemies. Can be recalled during BUY PHASE.

kit.name: Interceptor
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Interceptor</>. FIRE to place. REACTIVATE to activate. While active, destroy any enemy utility that can be shot or would bounce off players in range and line of sight. Can be recalled.

kit.name: Evolution
kit.description: INSTANTLY gain <teal>evolution</>. <teal>Evolution</> grants <teal>combat stim</>, continuous <teal>healing</>, and <teal>immunity</> to all debuffs and damage, except weapons.

kit.name: Gravity Well
kit.description: ACTIVATE a <whitebold>Star</> to create a zone that <debuffred>pulls</> all players to the center, exploding and applying <debuffred>vulnerable</> to all players.

kit.name: Nova Pulse
kit.description: ACTIVATE a <whitebold>Star</> to detonate it, <debuffred>concussing</> all players hit.

kit.name: Nebula
kit.description: ACTIVATE a <whitebold>Star</> to transform it into a smoke.

kit.name: Cosmic Divide
kit.description: ENTER <whitebold>Astral Form</>. ALT FIRE to EQUIP <whitebold>Cosmic Divide</>. FIRE to set, pivot and FIRE again to create an indestructible wall that blocks audio.

kit.name: Astral Form
kit.description: ACTIVATE ULTIMATE to ENTER <whitebold>Astral Form</>. FIRE to cast <whitebold>Stars</>. INTERACT to recall a <whitebold>Star</>. Recalling a <whitebold>Star</> forms a brief smoke.

kit.name: Stim Beacon
kit.description: INSTANTLY throw a <whitebold>Stim Beacon</>. On landing, create a zone that grants <teal>combat stim</> and <teal>haste</> to allies.

kit.name: Incendiary
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Incendiary</>. FIRE to launch. On landing, create a zone that deals <debuffred>damage</> to all players.

kit.name: Sky Smoke
kit.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set smoke locations. ALT FIRE to cast smokes.

kit.name: Orbital Strike
kit.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to cast an <whitebold>Orbital Strike</> at a location, dealing high <debuffred>damage</> over time to all players.

kit.name: Contingency
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Contingency</>. FIRE to push forward an indestructible vision-blocking wall. ALT FIRE for a slower wall.

kit.name: Undercut
kit.description: EQUIP an <whitebold>Undercut</>. FIRE to send it forward. Applies <debuffred>suppress</> and <debuffred>vulnerable</> to all players.

kit.name: Double Tap
kit.description: INSTANTLY channel <whitebold>Focus</>. Gain a shield that blocks one instance of damage.

kit.name: Kill Contract
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Kill Contract</>. FIRE to send forward a zone that pulls you and the first enemy hit into a duel. Channel <whitebold>Focus</> at the start of a duel.

kit.name: Focus
kit.description: While <whitebold>Focused</>, reload faster and spawn destructible energy orbs from dead enemies Iso has damaged or killed. When an energy orb is shot, grant a shield that blocks one instance of damage and refresh <whitebold>Focus</>.

kit.name: Pick-me-up
kit.description: ACTIVATE on a targeted dead enemy that you damaged or killed to gain <teal>haste</> and <teal>overheal</>.

kit.name: Meddle
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Meddle</>. FIRE to throw. Explodes on landing, <debuffred>decaying</> all players.

kit.name: Ruse
kit.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to set smoke locations. ALT FIRE to cast smokes. While dead, Clove can access <whitebold>Ruse</> to cast brief smokes.

kit.name: Not Dead Yet
kit.description: On death, ACTIVATE to channel a <teal>self-resurrect</>. During the channel, Clove is <teal>intangible</>. REACTIVATE to end the channel early. Once resurrected, secure a kill or damaging assist to stay alive.

kit.name: Fast Lane
kit.description: INSTANTLY launch two vision-blocking walls that extend until they hit a surface.

kit.name: Relay Bolt
kit.description: INSTANTLY throw a bolt that bounces once. Explodes on each surface, <debuffred>concussing</> all players.

kit.name: High Gear
kit.description: INSTANTLY consume fuel to gain <teal>haste</>. REACTIVATE to cancel. ALT FIRE to slide forward or in your movement direction. Slide resets every two kills.

kit.name: Overdrive
kit.description: INSTANTLY refresh <whitebold>High Gear</>. Access an accurate lightning beam that can be used while activating <whitebold>High Gear</>. FIRE to shoot. On kills, fully recharge fuel.

kit.name: Battery
kit.description: Passively recharge fuel over time.

kit.name: FAKEOUT
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Fakeout</>. FIRE to send a destructible clone forward. ALT FIRE to place a marker at your location. INTERACT to transform the marker into a clone. Clones continuously walk forward and will turn toward the first enemy that shoots it, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it.

kit.name: BLINDSIDE
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Blindside</>. FIRE to throw. After bouncing off a surface, explode, <debuffred>flashing</> all players looking at it.

kit.name: GATECRASH
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Gatecrash</>. FIRE to send it forward. ALT FIRE to place. REACTIVATE to teleport to it. INTERACT to fake a teleport. Resets every two kills.

kit.name: DIMENSIONAL DRIFT
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Dimensional Drift</>. FIRE to become <teal>intangible</> and <teal>invisible</>. <whitebold>Gatecrash</> is accessible during this state. REACTIVATE to exit early.

kit.name: Saturate
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Saturate</>. FIRE to throw. Explodes on landing, <debuffred>hindering</> all players.

kit.name: Lightspeed
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Lightspeed</>. FIRE to dash forward twice. ALT FIRE to dash forward once. Only the first dash can launch upward.

kit.name: Refract
kit.description: INSTANTLY place a marker at your location. REACTIVATE to travel to it. While traveling, Waylay is <teal>immune</> but cannot see enemies. Resets every two kills.

kit.name: Convergent Paths
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Convergent Paths</>. FIRE to gain <teal>haste</> and send forward a zone that <debuffred>hinders</> all players.

kit.name: Barrier Orb
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Barrier Orb</>. While equipped, REACTIVATE to pivot the wall or HOLD ALT FIRE to rotate. FIRE to place a destructible wall that fortifies after a delay.

kit.name: Slow Orb
kit.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>Slow Orb</>. FIRE to throw. On landing, create a zone that <debuffred>slows</> all players and plays an audio cue when enemies run through it.

kit.name: Healing Orb
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Healing Orb</>. FIRE on a damaged ally to grant <teal>healing</>. ALT FIRE to self-cast.

kit.name: Resurrection
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Resurrection</>. FIRE on a targeted dead ally to <teal>resurrect</> them.

kit.name: Leer
kit.description: EQUIP a destructible <whitebold>Leer</>. FIRE to send. After a delay, form, <debuffred>nearsighting</> enemies looking at it.

kit.name: Devour
kit.description: INSTANTLY consume a <whitebold>Soul Orb</> to <teal>heal</>. Excess healing is converted into <teal>overheal</>. While ULTIMATE is active, <whitebold>Devour</> auto-casts.

kit.name: Dismiss
kit.description: INSTANTLY consume a <whitebold>Soul Orb</> to briefly become <teal>intangible</>. REACTIVATE to cancel early. While ULTIMATE is active, also gain <teal>invisibility</>.

kit.name: Empress
kit.description: INSTANTLY gain <teal>Empress</>. <teal>Empress</> grants <teal>combat stim</>, endless <whitebold>Soul Orb</> consumption, and permanent <teal>overheal</>.

kit.name: Vitality
kit.description: Spawn a <whitebold>Soul Orb</> from dead enemies Reyna has damaged or killed.

kit.name: Shrouded Step
kit.description: EQUIP a <whitebold>Shrouded Step</>. FIRE to briefly channel, then teleport to a targeted location.

kit.name: Paranoia
kit.description: EQUIP <whitebold>Paranoia</>. FIRE to send it forward. Applies <debuffred>nearsight</> and <debuffred>deafens</> all players.

kit.name: Dark Cover
kit.description: ENTER Shadow Vision. REACTIVATE to cast a smoke. HOLD FIRE/ALT FIRE to adjust distance. RELOAD to toggle view.

kit.name: From the Shadows
kit.description: EQUIP a tactical map. FIRE to begin a teleport to a selected location. While teleporting, Omen appears as a destructible shade at the destination. REACTIVATE to cancel.

kit.name: Cloudburst
kit.description: INSTANTLY throw a cloud. Forms into a brief smoke on any surface or after a delay. HOLD ACTIVATE to steer towards your crosshair.

kit.name: Updraft
kit.description: INSTANTLY propel high into the air.

kit.name: Tailwind
kit.description: INSTANTLY prepare a dash. REACTIVATE to dash forward or in your movement direction. Resets every two kills.

kit.name: Blade Storm
kit.description: INSTANTLY access five accurate throwing knives that deal <debuffred>lethal damage</> with direct hits to the head. FIRE to shoot. On kills, refresh your knives. ALT FIRE to throw all remaining knives without a refresh.

kit.description: HOLD JUMP while falling to <teal>glide</>.

roles.Controller: Controllers are experts in slicing up dangerous territory to set their team up for success.
roles.Duelist: Duelists are self-sufficient fraggers who their team expects, through abilities and skills, to get high frags and seek out engagements first.
roles.Initiator: Initiators challenge angles by setting up their team to enter contested ground and push defenders away.
roles.Sentinel: Sentinels are defensive experts who can lock down areas and watch flanks, both on attacker and defender rounds.

standard.description: Plant/defuse mode. Unranked matches, full map pool, attack and defend, classic gameplay. First to 13 wins.

swiftplay.description: Plant/defuse mode. Quicker matches, same core rules, same objectives, accelerated economy. First to 5 wins.
